_about: The team's art references: the one list every art tool and the Art Director agent compares against (tools/art_check.py --references and --gate, tools/art_judge.py, tools/art_ref_check.py, tools/art_loop.py, tools/art_judge_prompt.md, tools/assetgen.py practice stand-ins, tools/submission_check.py assets). Reference only, never shipped: GDD 1.3 7C and its Provenance line ('Do not copy into the jam entry'); Official Rules 7(h) (game content is made during the Contest Period); a shipped byte copy of any file here fails submission_check.py assets. Schema (one list, `references`): id; path (repo-relative: under pipeline/art/reference/, or the team's own art folder for a team-art entry; null for kind described); kind (image | data | described); role (list, every value a key of `roles`); what; cards (Day-0 cards and MVP items judged against it: a Day-0 card listed on an image runs tools/art_ref_check.py, art_judge.py coverage); consulted_by (other cards and checks that read it without an art_ref_check verdict; art_check --references lists them with cards); judge (true = the blind X/Y judge sees it as style context); required (art_check --references and --gate fail while it is missing; false on an image = optional: a checkout without the file leaves the entry out of the list and out of every judge element, so the team-art entries work in repos that have only some of the files); judge_exempt (why no judge element uses it); tier (top = quality bar); cell (frame size of a sheet); description (kind described: the written target); note; origin. Kind data with role layout = the frame grids, pivots and fps (the source for sprite sidecars). elements and scene = what tools/art_judge.py scores; quality_bar = the top tier; gdd_embedded = images the current GDD embeds join the list automatically; team_art = every image under Assets/ and Mockups/ joins the list automatically (folders named obsolete skipped, already-listed paths and byte copies skipped), look only, never shipped. Practice repos only (.pipeline-practice): `tools/assetgen.py image --provider reference` (and any image step with no key) places the best-matching picture here by role as a stand-in, provenance `source=reference (practice)`; on the team repo assetgen refuses it and submission_check.py assets fails such a row.
note: Every reference image the art is judged against: the curated set in this repo under pipeline/art/reference/ (Git LFS; `origin` says where each came from), plus the team's own art folders (Assets/, Mockups/: the described studies below and, through team_art, any image the team adds). References only, never shipped or imported (Official Rules §7(h): no game content before Nov 12; jam art is generated during the jam). tools/art_judge.py and tools/art_ref_check.py read this file: `scene` scores build screenshots, `elements` score generated art; each art card's own references are the ones listing it in `cards`. The evidence line carries refs=<first 12 hex of this file's sha256>, so a PASS made against an older or smaller set is refused (tools/check_pr.py rule artref). GDD SH1.0 (12 Nov): these pictures are judging targets for the art loop and art_ref_check.py, never generation inputs (ART-03, BG-02); card numbers follow the SH1.0 MVP list and the art cards 0.37-0.41.

roles.composition target: the whole-frame look a capture is judged against (layout, value structure, mood)
roles.character poses: Ella and umbrella poses and states (UP_OPEN, ATTACK_DESCENT, SHIELD_DESCENT, free fall)
roles.owl: the clockwork owl: body, chest clock, wing damage rows, its attack patterns
roles.palette: style.json palette and paper texture were measured from it
roles.scale: gameplay size and proportions at 1080p, background layer sizes
roles.quality bar: the top tier for rendering quality and finish: every art-loop round is also judged blind against one (quality_bar)
roles.pattern: attack-pattern diagrams: shapes and timing, not art style
roles.layout: frame grids, pivots and fps: the source for sprite sidecars (.sprite.json)
roles.menu style bar: a written target for menu screens and transitions (no image)
roles.team art: a picture the team added to its art folders (Assets/, Mockups/; team_art): look only, gameplay comes from the GDD
roles.menu screen: the title or another menu screen a menu card builds to (layout, title lockup, menu placement, mood)
roles.motion: how an attack or a mechanism moves (poses, timing, parts): never the look (D-new-owl-look)

quality_bar.rule: Top tier, on top of the key-art composition target. Every art-loop round also puts our piece blind against a quality-bar image (bar-casters for characters and shot VFX, bar-other-realm for the scene and wind); a round passes only when the critic picks neither the piece reference nor the quality bar over ours. A frame or piece that reads as flat primitives or a rough placeholder is an automatic FAIL (screen_check.py flat/grey/outline, the element judge's flat-fill and off-palette caps).
quality_bar.palette_note: The quality-bar colours (ash-blue flow, the yellows) and the key art's shot rust (D-new-owl-shot-look; the bar's hot red #FF3658 and coral are not our look) are in style.json as capped accents (Josh, DECIDED 2026-11-10, D-new-palette-accents): art_check.py accepts them only in their role, hue band and share cap.

vfx_spec.construction: bright core, shell, trail, light spill on nearby surfaces
vfx_spec.rule: The spec for every shot VFX (owl bolts, wand shots, impacts): each one has the four stages and the core/shell/trail build, taken from bar-casters for build quality only. The owl's shot colour is the key art's rust-red needle with a crosshair ring (Josh, DECIDED 2026-11-11, D-new-owl-shot-look: RUST, RUST SHADOW, RUST HIGH measured from the key art); the pink chevrons (#FF3658) are not the look. style.json carries them as the shot-red and shot-yellow capped accents, INK with the darks (see quality_bar.palette_note).

gdd_embedded._about: Images the current GDD embeds (markdown ![..](path) or , relative to the GDD file) join the list each run: the GDD a run picked with kickoff --gdd ($JAM_GDD, tools/gdd_select.py, which prints the images it brings) is read, else the one docs/gdd/CURRENT names. An entry above with the same path keeps its role and cards. Not required: a GDD without images adds none.

team_art._about: Every image (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, any case) under the team's art folders joins the list each run (tools/art_check.py load_spec, the loader every art tool shares), unless it is already listed: the same path, or the same bytes as a listed file or as a team image joined before it (an LFS pointer compares by its object id). A folder whose name says obsolete (for example Assets/'... Test Assets - obsolete') is skipped. A joined image gets these defaults: kind image, role team art, judge true (style context for the blind judge, look only like the #art-direction posts: gameplay comes from the GDD), no judge element and no card until the Art Director gives it its own entry above, and it is never shipped (submission_check.py assets). An image that cannot be read (not the picture its extension says, empty or truncated) fails art_check.py --references and --gate, art_judge.py coverage and kickoff --check; both print a `team art:` line with how many images joined.
